verdict.rationale: Cursor publishes its own API reference. The Cloud Agents API docs point to a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec "for detailed schemas and examples", the Admin API is documented section by section, and the SDK Cookbook ships end-to-end examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (no try-it console or in-browser request runner), so only the reference-with-examples half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: an interactive explorer for API endpoints, examples runnable directly from the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of the docs experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
